examples.src: It was raining; nevertheless, we went out.
examples.dst: Hujan turun; meskipun demikian, kami tetap keluar.

examples.src: The plan is risky. Nevertheless, we should try.
examples.dst: Rencananya berisiko. Meskipun demikian, kita harus mencoba.

payload.notes: Formal. Commoner in writing than in speech — in casual Indonesian walaupun begitu is more natural.
